description: A business's locations, services, prices, add-ons and what it asks to be paid up front, the same as its booking page shows and nothing else. Needs no sign-in. With more than one open location, answer again with its `locationId` to see its services.

business.description: The business's address from find_business, such as "studio-noord", or its booking page link.

locationId.description: A location's id, when the business has more than one open location.

name: get_business
title: Get Business
